data.summary: Finance Operations Professional with 4 years of experience in hedge fund and money market operations, specializing in trade processing, NAV support (pre- and post-trade), payment operations (SWIFT), cash reconciliation, and FX processing. Skilled in trade settlement client service, and handling high-volume transactions, resolving operational exceptions, ensuring regulatory compliance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver accurate and timely results.

experience.role: Associate-II, Transfer Agency Vertical: Hedge Fund & Mutual Fund
responsibilities: Managed Money Market operations and ensured timely and accurate settlement of client fund transactions.
Processed subscriptions, redemptions, switches, and transfers for Hedge Fund and Mutual Fund clients.
Monitored and validated SWIFT MT535 and MT536 messages to support reconciliation and settlement activities.
Processed daily FX rate updates by validating client files and uploading rates to investor accounts.
Performed cash reconciliation and resolved transaction exceptions within SLA timelines.
Handled payment operations, including validation, processing, and settlement of domestic and international payments.
Investigated payment breaks using SWIFT message tracking and coordinated with internal teams for timely resolution.
Managed high-volume transactions while maintaining accuracy, quality, and operational efficiency.
Collaborated with global teams across Ireland and Luxembourg to resolve client queries and operational issues.
Ensured compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and operational guidelines.
